data.name: Billing: Check Invoices
data.markdowncontent:
--- name: billingCheckInvoicesSkill description: Generates recurring invoices for active products due within 15 days and auto-pays invoiced invoices through Stripe. Notification emails are sent by the Billing Send Invoice skill. ---
# Billing: Check Invoices
Generates recurring invoices for active products whose next bill date falls within the next 15 days, then attempts Stripe autopay on every invoice in `invoiced` status with `isautopaid=true`. Notification emails are sent by the Billing Send Invoice skill (`billingSendInvoiceSkill`), which runs as the next step of the billing scenario.
## When to use
- A scheduled billing run should create upcoming recurring invoices and process pending autopayments.
## How it works
1. Searches `collectiveproduct` for products with `recurring=true`, `billingstatus=active` and `nextbillon` within the next 15 days (sorted by `nextbillon` ascending). 2. Skips products that already have an invoice generated within 15 days of the due date (`lastgeneratedinvoicedate`). 3. For each eligible product, creates a `collectiveinvoice` with `paymentstatus=sendinvoice`, resolves the billing contacts from `sentto` or the collection's billing contacts, and advances the product's `nextbillon` by its `recurringperiod` months. 4. Searches `collectiveinvoice` for `paymentstatus=invoiced` and `isautopaid=true`; for each invoice it looks up the Stripe customer `billing+<collectionid>@entermediadb.com`, charges the first stored source, and marks the invoice `paid` or `autopayfailed` with a reason (`No Customer`, `No Credit Cards Stored`, `CreditCard failed`).
## Inputs
None - operates on catalog data.
## Outputs
- A summary of how many recurring invoices were generated and how many pending invoices were auto-paid.
## Implementation
- Bean `billingCheckInvoicesSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.BillingCheckInvoicesSkill` - Agent type: `taskagent` - Java port of `plugins/catalog/html/events/scripts/billing/checkinvoices.groovy`

data.name: Billing: Send Invoices
data.markdowncontent:
--- name: billingSendInvoiceSkill description: Sends invoice notification emails - for a single invoice by id (via the invoiceid context value) or in bulk over all invoices waiting to be sent. ---
# Billing: Send Invoices
Sends the invoice notification emails. With an `invoiceid` context value it handles that single invoice; without one it does a bulk pass over every invoice with `notificationsent=false` and `paymentstatus=sendinvoice`.
## When to use
- A billing run should email the generated invoices to their billing contacts (typically the step after Billing: Check Invoices). - A single invoice needs its notification (re)sent by id.
## How it works
1. With an `invoiceid`: loads the invoice and branches on `paymentstatus` - `error` is left alone; anything not `paid` gets the invoice notification sent to `sentto` (plus the `invoice_cc_email` copy) and is marked `paymentstatus=invoiced`, `notificationsent=true`; a `paid` invoice that has not been notified yet gets the paid notification and is marked `notificationpaidsent=true`. 2. Without an `invoiceid`: searches `collectiveinvoice` for `notificationsent=false` and `paymentstatus=sendinvoice`; for each invoice it emails the billing contacts (and the `invoice_cc_email` copy) and notifies the project team (`librarycollection.contactemail`). One failing invoice is logged and skipped so the rest of the batch still runs. 3. Each email is rendered from the community's theme templates (`invoice-to-client.html`, `invoice-to-client-monthly.html` for monthly recurring, `send-paid-invoice-event.html`, `invoice-to-notify-team.html`) with the pay-now action URL, invoice dates, currency and pay options.
## Inputs
- `invoiceid` (optional): id of a single `collectiveinvoice` to notify. Omit for the bulk pass.
## Outputs
- A summary of what was sent per run.
## Implementation
- Bean `billingSendInvoiceSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.BillingSendInvoiceSkill` - Agent type: `taskagent` - Java port of `plugins/catalog/html/events/scripts/billing/sendinvoice.groovy`
